polityNote: Kingdom of Belgium. First level modelled as the provinces plus, from 1995-01-01 when it ceased to belong to Brabant, the Brussels-Capital Region (the layout data/hist-admin-fill.js and Natural Earth use). The Brussels-Capital Region existed from 1989 inside Brabant province; OpenHistoricalMap draws it from 1989-01-12 and the build yields to that record. Scope starts at the 1977 commune merger (statoids lists no inter-provincial transfer after the 1962 law); OpenHistoricalMap answers several provinces up to 1980 and is preferred there. Atoms: geoBoundaries BEL ADM2 (Statistics Belgium, 2015).

sources.title: Provinces of Belgium (Statoids, Gwillim Law) — change history
sources.says: Last inter-provincial transfers by the law of 1962-11-08 (Mouscron to Hainaut, Fourons to Limburg); 1977-01-01 communes merged into 589; 1995-01-01 Brabant divided into Flemish Brabant, Walloon Brabant and the Brussels-Capital Region. No other transfer between provinces is listed.
